blocks.prompt: 9. Let \(f\) be continuous, \(\int_{0}^{2} f(x)\,dx = 5\). If the average value of \(f\) on \([0, 4]\) is twice the average value on \([0, 2]\), find \(\int_{2}^{4} f(x)\,dx\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein \(f\) ka formula diya hi nahin, aur zaroorat bhi nahin: average sirf integral \(\div\) lambai hai.
Diya kya hai? \([0, 2]\) par integral 5, aur \([0, 4]\) ka average \([0, 2]\) ke average ka do guna.
Find kya karna hai? \(\int_2^4 f\).
Plan: ise \(I\) kaho, dono averages likho, "do guna" wali shart se equation banao aur \(I\) nikaalo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int_{0}^{2} f(x)\,dx = 5\); \(f_{\text{av}}[0, 4] = 2\,f_{\text{av}}[0, 2]\).
Maloom karna: \(I = \int_{2}^{4} f(x)\,dx\).
Tareeqa: \(f_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{b-a}\int_a^b f\), aur \(\int_{0}^{4} = \int_{0}^{2} + \int_{2}^{4}\).

\([0, 2]\) par average
\[f_{\text{av}}[0, 2] = \dfrac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2} f(x)\,dx = \dfrac{5}{2}\]
Kyun: interval ki lambai \(2 - 0 = 2\).

\([0, 4]\) par average
\[\int_{0}^{4} f(x)\,dx = 5 + I\]
\[f_{\text{av}}[0, 4] = \dfrac{5 + I}{4}\]
Kyun: definite integral ko beech mein kisi point (yahan 2) par tora ja sakta hai: poora = pehla hissa + doosra hissa. Lambai \(4 - 0 = 4\).

"Do guna" wali shart
\[\dfrac{5 + I}{4} = 2\cdot\dfrac{5}{2} = 5\]
\[5 + I = 20 \Rightarrow I = 15\]
Kyun: dono taraf 4 se multiply kiya, phir 5 minus kiya.
Dhyan dein: \(\int_0^4 = 20\) par ruk jana ghalat hai; sawal sirf \([2, 4]\) wala hissa maang raha hai.

Tasdeeq
\(\int_0^4 f = 20\), average \(= 5\); \([0, 2]\) par average \(= 2.5\), aur \(5 = 2 \times 2.5\;\checkmark\).
